description: Asks CodeGene to start a NEW project (a site or app that does not exist yet) from a name and what the person wants built. It is a QUESTION for the person, never a start: the person approves it, in a prompt your client shows them (when it can) or on the CodeGene page whose link the answer gives. Never approve it yourself, and never say it exists until get_approval says so. Once approved, a plan for the first version comes back first, and nothing is built until the person approves that plan in CodeGene. To rebuild a site that already lives elsewhere, send site_url instead: the answer is a CodeGene link where the person sees the plan and its price and starts it themselves; give them that link. To change an existing project use request_change. If a prompt you expected never appeared, do not ask again: call get_approval with the requestId.

description.description: What the person wants built, in their own words: what it is for, who it is for, what it must have. Needed unless site_url is given.

finish_with.description: Leave out. "link" skips the approval prompt and returns the CodeGene page to send the person, for an assistant that cannot show prompts from a tool.

name.description: The new project's name, such as "Clay Corner".

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

site_url.description: Only to rebuild a site that already exists elsewhere: its address. The answer is then a CodeGene link where the person sees the plan and its price and starts it themselves.

workspace_id.description: The workspace (whoami lists them). May be left out when the connection has only one.

name: create_project
title: Ask CodeGene to start a new project
